cr_data.provenance: Georgia O’Keeffe (1887–1986), New York and New Mexico, then Abiquiú, NM, from 1949; sold to Paul Rosenbaum (1897–1982) and Gabriella Rosenbaum (1905–2000; born Gabriella Kramer), Chicago and Palm Springs, FL, 1969 [documentation in curatorial object file]; by descent to Gabriella Rosenbaum; bequeathed to the Art Institute of Chicago, 2002. (Source: Art Institute of Chicago website, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946.... No signature" [notes backing inscription 2]. O'Keeffe wrote: ". . am still at another painting of the White Place" (O'Keeffe to Maria Chabot, 24 March 1943). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: The White Place in Sun

credit_line: Bequest of Paul and Gabriella Rosenbaum
description: Tall, chalky white cliffs stand on either side of the composition, forming a V-shape at its center. The formations are narrow and tall. Horizontal crags run through the cliffs. Behind them, a bright blue sky stretches across the canvas.
imageCaption: Courtesy of the Art Institute of Chicago.
title: The White Place in Sun
